title: Los Hombres No Lloran
overview: When his abusive father is about to be taken off life support, Joaquin avoids the hospital and escapes with his best friend, while his wife Lucia urges him to go say goodbye. Joaquin must decide whether to face the past or keep running.

title: Freedom 7
overview: On May 5, 1961, Alan Shepard became the first American in space. He was launched into a sub-orbital ballistic trajectory onboard a Mercury capsule, Freedom 7, the flight lasting approximately 15 minutes. This documentary provides an astronaut-point-of-view story of the project.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

title: Flesh & Fuel
overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: One Minute to Midnight
overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. Before traveling to Italy to deal with the inheritance, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock of his life. Between conversations with his activist daughter and encounters with ghosts from his past, he begins to question his very existence, and, above all, his relationships with women.

title: The Education of Jane Cumming
overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

title: Spring
overview: In a Russian-occupied town in southeastern Ukraine, where burying the dead has been forbidden, the church of a young priest, Andriy, has been turned into a morgue for executed Ukrainian civilians. As the occupation tightens its grip, Andriy quietly begins to resist, secretly returning the bodies to their families at great personal risk. Along the way, he forms an unexpected bond with Makarov, an 11-year-old boy who becomes the silent witness to his rebellion.

title: Table For Two
overview: A food critic with high standards realizes the flaws in perfection and redefines their relationship both with food and their partner through an out-of-body experience.

title: la lutte armée n'est pas un jeu d'enfant
Naughty
overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.

title: Photograph 51
overview: Inspired by the true story of Rosalind Franklin, the groundbreaking British scientist who first unveiled the hidden structure of DNA but whose legacy has been overshadowed.

title: Ranger
overview: Based on the novel by Aseem Arora.

title: I Fought the Law
overview: Emerging from a complacent population, Spike and Iggy are two young men who find a spirit of rebellion in punk rock as they challenge authority and antagonize law enforcement.  A contemporary Western punk rock hangout film.

title: Redemptions
overview: Marcel, a retired hitman, is forced back into action and commits two murders in Montreal. In doing so, he unwittingly sets in motion a chain of unforeseen events that will ultimately endanger the life of his own daughter in Paris.

title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
overview: Follows hospital workers who keep 400 people alive inside Cama Hospital while armed assailants strike the city during terror attacks in India.

title: The Cross of Scotland
overview: About a Young wrestler talking about his experiences in wrestling and his future.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: I'm Still Kind of a Daydreamer
overview: With graduation just around the corner, Lily Chen, who's dreaming of becoming a novelist, is working hard to beat procrastination. As she juggles between reality and her dreams, the big question is: can she finish her novel and step confidently into the next phase of her life?

title: Violette
overview: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: Nina Roza
overview: A viral video of an 8-year-old Bulgarian artist catches the eye of a major art collector, and Mihail is sent there, 30 years after leaving his home country, to assess the value of the girl's work and confront ghosts from his past.

title: Orange-Flavoured Wedding
overview: The Puig family has seven children. And today is the wedding of the youngest: Jacques. It's March 1978 in a church in a suburb of Nantes. The father isn't attending the wedding; he's been banished from the family. Jacques is marrying Martine, a young woman who lives in the same neighborhood. It's a love match. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: Un train peut en cacher un autre [Marcel ! (I, II, III, IV)]
overview: Film performance involving one super-8 projector and three 16mm projectors screening choreographically the four films that compose up to date the series Marcel !, produced from 2021 to 2025 between Brussels and Madrid. This project takes as its point of departure the exhibition Poèmes industriels, lettres ouvertes (WIELS Contemporary Art Center, Brussels, 2021-2022), devoted to Marcel Broodthaers’ Industrial Poems (1968-1972).

title: Gunpowder
overview: When an amateur author gets the interview of a lifetime in his home, his flatmates decide its the best time to do an arms deal in the same house

title: UVĬDUS
overview: A humid world of green, rot, stagnant water, and slow decay.

title: The Abyss Beneath Us
overview: In search of answers, a troubled sleepwalker returns to his hometown to uncover the truth about his friend’s mysterious disappearance. As he ventures further, he descends into the darkest corners of his subconscious.

title: Mother's Home
overview: On Christmas Eve, a teenager has an orgasm while dreaming of his mother. The next day, he has to face her with this idea in mind.

title: Créatures de Papier
overview: Unaware that they are both involved with Capucine, Henri and Charles debate historical and literary figures in a Parisian bookstore.

title: WWE Wrestlepalooza 2026
overview: The 2026 Wrestlepalooza, also promoted as Wrestlepalooza: Perth, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the sixth overall Wrestlepalooza event and the second under the WWE banner, as well as the first Wrestlepalooza to be held outside of North America. The event will take place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at RAC Arena in Perth, Western Australia.

title: The Smith Family Movie
overview: The Smith Family Movie is a high-energy,  Live-Action holiday comedy-adventure centered around 12-year-old Aaliyah Smith (played by breakout star Pink Pinkett Jones). The story kicks off during the family’s chaotic, ultra-loud annual Christmas party, where Aaliyah is struggling to get her eccentric relatives to notice her passion for music. To bring everyone together, her aunt surprises the family with an all-expenses-paid winter vacation to a luxury holiday resort.

title: Once Upon a Time In Gotham
overview: Something is going on in Gotham when the White Rabbit falls down the rabbit hole that is Gotham City. She encounters a series of unfortunate events and runs into the key players of the town. Finding herself face-to-face with infamous villains and comic book heroes.

title: THE END OF GIRPH
overview: The end of an era. Oliver Murphy takes an introspective look back at his teenage years in this psychological comedic neo-noir character study, as he is forced to face his issues head-on and his life is thrown into turmoil while uncertainty looms.

title: Isn't It Called True Love?
overview: Harry, a young tradie relives moments of love and loss, confronting the question of what someone would do for love once its gone?

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.

title: A Man at the End of the World
overview: In a dystopian version of 2009, cargo delivery specialist Cole Dawson is forced into a covert operation, where he uncovers a horrifying secret with the potential to send what’s left of mankind into extinction.

title: The Last Whale Singer
overview: When a monstrous creature escapes from a melting iceberg, a self-doubting teenage humpback whale must face his greatest fears and dive into the darkest depths with his friends, to discover the mystical song that can save the oceans from destruction.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
overview: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.

title: Love Is a Gypsy Child: A Carmen Story
overview: Andalusia, Spain, 1840. After three years of wandering, Salva, who works as an assistant to a blind knife sharpener, returns to Seville, his hometown, where he meets Carmen, a gypsy woman with a captivating voice.

title: La bola negra
overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

title: Danger
overview: Simon, a disillusioned developer, carries a secret that could dismantle modern society: a code capable of remote neural hijacking. Hunted by his former architects, he seeks sanctuary within the echoing halls of the Musée d’Orsay—one of Paris’s final "safe zones" in a world of total digital surveillance. There, among the relics of the past, he must join a clandestine resistance to protect the future of human autonomy.

title: SUPERBOUND
overview: The world's most powerful hero must babysit an immature recruit with superpowers she can't control.  From the minds that made The GRIMEY Trilogy, experience the incredible journey of Killswitch & Grace Crowne as they team up to stop the biggest threat to their world.

title: The Tallyman
overview: Up and coming vigilante, the Tallyman, faces his biggest threat yet when he comes across a larger than life figure.

title: Faceless: Retribution
overview: After the devastating effects of Beast: The Omen, the world is in ruin. The Magician has just collected the pillars of power and harnessed them to kill half of all life, leaving Josh, Roonald, and The Beast stranded in the cursed forest. Those who remain of the MHHM characters band together in hopes of defeating The Magician once and for all, no matter what sacrifices must be made.

title: Follow Your Beat
overview: When aspiring DJ Yamilet learns the record store she works at is being forced to close, she rallies her community to try and save it.

title: Minnesota Not Built
overview: Liam suspects that the recent outbreak his father had, was actually a "cognitively uncontrolled enthalpy outbreak," which leads him to discover that, all of this was purposeful and was in the plans of something.

title: Imperfect
overview: The feature film debut for Real Inck Studios, and passion project of writer-director Luke Sorenson, Imperfect portrays the story of Nizan (Shiloh Heffernan) over one fateful day, as his life is changed forever when a mysterious figure offers him the chance at a different life.

title: AMER D'I
overview: Isaiah is a young man who decides to leave his family and friends to live and wander the streets of Paris after a painful past event.  Amidst encounters, ghosts, drugs, and self-destruction, Iz will plunge headlong into the capital.

title: The Dream: Love & War
overview: "The Dream: Love & War" is an Indian romantic action drama film that follows the journey of Arin, a young man caught between ambition, love, and conflict. As he struggles to achieve his dreams, his life changes after meeting Sia, whose presence brings both hope and emotional challenges. Set against themes of romance, sacrifice, betrayal, and survival, the story explores how love and war can shape a person’s destiny. The film combines emotional storytelling with dramatic action and relationship-driven conflicts.

title: Un homme libre
overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

title: Not 8½
overview: Three film students are searching for ideas for their original documentaries. They sift through topics, argue, harbor doubts, and try to find a story that has never been told before. Will they manage to come up with something truly unique—and will they ultimately find their film?

title: We Are All Strangers
overview: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family.

title: I Play Rocky
overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet: surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

title: Roma elastica
overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

title: Sheep in the Box
overview: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

title: Nick and the Jade Tree
overview: Nick is a caterpillar boy who, having overcome the taboo of the swamp, becomes a butterfly and, regardless of difficulties, strives for his dream - the Magic jade tree, where all the most beautiful butterflies of the world live. Dangerous trials, fun adventures, new friends and, of course, first love await Nick on his way.

title: Ivanna 2
overview: Five years after surviving a massacre at a nursing home, Ambar, Dika, and Rina face Ivanna’s terror once again in a hospital. When a nurse is found beheaded, they realize Ivanna has returned and must be stopped before more victims fall.

title: The Christmas Rescue: A Big Movie
overview: When Christmas is suddenly put in danger, Elmo and his friends must jump into action and race against time to save the holiday. With the North Pole's systems failing and chaos spreading across the city, the team embarks on a fast-paced rescue mission filled with wild obstacles, unexpected challenges, and nonstop holiday excitement. As the clock ticks down, they discover that only teamwork, quick thinking, and courage can stop Christmas from disappearing forever.

title: The Ambersons
overview: After another ordinary day at work, a lonely suburban father returns home to the family he has built for himself.

title: Untitled Doctor Who Christmas Special
overview: Plot TBA.

overview: When Peter’s contract lands in the bin, his mind soon follows. A darkly absurd descent into office paranoia, ambition, and avocado toast.

After being sexually assaulted by her boss, she sets out to seek revenge, committing crimes that start drawing the attention of detective Benjamín Flores. As Benjamín investigates the cases, he unexpectedly begins to fall in love with Ramona, unaware that she is the one behind the violent acts.

overview: In the mid 2010s, two best friends ran a vlogging YouTube channel while they were in high school. In 2026, a deranged fan dresses as their fictional clown mascot and kidnaps the two friends to try and convince them to make just one more vlog.

overview: This is an Action Thriller Film and this movie will be streaming on Youtube  For Free!! This film is coming in English and Hindi

title: The Pools
overview: A teenager who slips out of reality and becomes trapped in an endless, echoing aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. While trying to navigate the mysterious waters, find a way out, and solve the space's sinister puzzles, the protagonist realizes they are being pursued by a malevolent entity.

title: Blackwood
overview: After discovering his brother’s brutal death,  A man embarks on a relentless quest for vengeance. As he descends into the city’s violent underworld, he sets out to destroy the ruthless gang known as “The Blackwoods.”

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Tie Man
overview: Marjolaine, model police officer, hasn't been the same since her parents were murdered and her sister kidnapped. She joins forces with TIE MAN, a disfigured vigilante to seek revenge against the man responsible, the power mad Franz DeMann.

title: The Baltimorons
overview: A newly sober man's Christmas Eve dental emergency leads to an unexpected romance with his older dentist as they explore Baltimore together.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: It will happen tonight
overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

title: The Daughters of Abraham
overview: After several years apart, Myriam, a young woman from a Muslim background who grew up in Marseille, reconnects with Eva, who comes from a Jewish family, during the summer vacation. Together, they live out their youth outside the imposed norms. But this carefree summer begins to unravel when a tragedy upends the balance of their social and family circles—and soon, their own destinies.

overview: Henri has become a real jerk. It’s been two years since his relationship with Émilie ended. Everyone has moved on. Not him. His job as a photographer no longer interests him, and human relationships even less. Bitter and increasingly alone. Until the day a man breaks into his home.

overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

overview: When her father dies after challenging a divine being called "The Tennis God" to a table tennis match, Kat finally gets the chance to prove to everyone that she's the best. All she has to do is beat The Tennis God. How hard can it be?

overview: Two likely brothers saving the world from the biggest dangers of their lives before their fantastically quirky world will be destroyed.

After not even a day living in her new home, she and a new friend set in motion a series of events that lead the two to being swept up in transpacific gang conflicts, a threat from the president, and the invention of time travel.

title: El mágico cerebro de un hombre atormentado
For If Night Leaves Something Undone, the Day Undertakes to Complete It
overview: A found 16mm print of a short narrative film set in the American Civil War, along with Super 8 home movies of the filmmaker’s family in Iran during the Iran-Iraq War in the 1980s, are fused into a ghostly labyrinth. Made entirely on a JK Optical Printer, the film exhumes gestures, movements, conflicts, and forces in constant resurgence.

title: The Aching Echo
overview: Hải Vy, a 12th grade student losing faith in her passion for art, leaves her university choice blank under mounting pressure. In crisis, she falls into The Aching Echo, a surreal world of her own creation, where meeting her younger self rekindles her reason to create.

title: A Dor e o Silêncio do Infinito
The Wyverns
overview: Jura, summer 1912. Two sisters, Marie (11 years old) and Suzanne (15), flee their daily lives for  cross the forest and reach the cave of the Vouivre, legendary female figure and  incarnation of nature, supposed to devour those who dare to challenge it. Between belief and  emancipation, their expedition takes an unexpected turn. The Vouivre may not exist  Not but the myth becomes a weapon.

overview: A fan-made adaptation of Martín Paredes's Web Series currently in development by TurtleBak Productions. Plot TBA.

overview: Krissi convinces her friends to throw a politically incorrect party. However, she learns the hard way that no one is immune to exclusion.

title: The Ultra-Verse
overview: Across countless realities, a single threat begins to unravel everything. Bootleg Bill’s power is spreading faster than anyone can contain, forcing heroes from different worlds to cross paths for the first time. As the boundaries between realities start to collapse, unlikely allies must come together and face a danger that none of them can defeat alone. Old secrets surface, new alliances are tested, and the battle for the survival of every world begins. The Ultra Club will never be the same.

title: Communitas
overview: Even in group projects, we tend to individualize ourselves. We ignore the collective which describes or rather embodies the ensemble of chaotic notes, chaotic songs, chaotic experiences, the very chaos which is a natural part of consciousness. For this project, we asked how does music induce or mediate collective flow states, and breakdown the idea of an absolute monolithic autonomic self through collective artistic expression?

overview: Two friends from college reconnect after several years, little do they know they will discover something very unexpected.
